title: Grammar — Infinitives and Gerunds as Objects (My Next Grammar, Lessons 20-21)
intro: An infinitive is to + verb, such as to read. A gerund is a verb ending in -ing used as a noun, such as reading.

explanation.title: Infinitives and Gerunds Quick Guide
explanation.intro: 這次 Grammar 主要考「動詞後面的受詞」要用 to + verb 還是 V-ing。

cards.meaning: 像名詞一樣放在動詞後面，表示想做、需要做、希望做的事。
examples: Mia hopes to be a doctor.

cards.meaning: V-ing 當名詞用，也可以放在某些動詞後面當受詞。
用來說活動或休閒行程。

tips: 看到 would like，後面通常接 noun 或 to + verb: I would like apple juice. / I would like to help.
看到 enjoy、dislike、finish、keep、quit，後面通常接 V-ing.
考題問 object type 時，先找動詞後面的答案：computers 是 noun，to sleep 是 infinitive，smoking 是 gerund.

items.q: Choose the infinitive as the object: Maya wants ____ after school.
Choose the infinitive as the object: The class decided ____ a garden.
Which words are the infinitive? Leo hopes to join the soccer team.
Which sentence uses an infinitive as an object correctly?
Choose the best answer: My brother promised ____ his room.
Choose the best answer: We need ____ more water.
Choose the best answer: I would like ____ a healthy lunch.
Which sentence has the same meaning? Sam plans a visit to the museum.
choices: Sam plans to visit the museum.
Sam is visiting the museum now.

items.q: Choose the gerund as the object: Nora enjoys ____ stories.
Choose the gerund as the object: Dad finished ____ dinner.
Which word is the gerund? Talia likes reading after breakfast.
Which sentence uses a gerund as an object correctly?
Choose the best answer: Please stop ____ during the movie.
Choose the best answer: The kids practiced ____ the song.
Choose the best answer: We discussed ____ less plastic.
Which sentence has a gerund used as a noun?
Choose the best answer: I hope ____ a scientist one day.
Choose the best answer: I avoid ____ too much candy.
Choose the best answer: They agreed ____ the classroom.
Choose the best answer: She misses ____ with her old friends.

practiceSets.title: Lesson 20 — Infinitives as Objects
practiceSets.description: Choose or identify to + verb used after verbs like want, need, hope, plan, decide, and promise.

items.q: Choose the best answer: I forgot ____ my notebook.
Choose the best answer: The team plans ____ early.
Which words are the infinitive? We learned to recycle bottles.
Which sentence is correct?

practiceSets.title: Lesson 21 — Gerunds as Objects
practiceSets.description: Choose or identify -ing verbs used as nouns after verbs like enjoy, finish, practice, avoid, stop, and discuss.

items.q: Choose the best answer: Ben enjoys ____ about bugs.
Choose the best answer: We finished ____ the poster.
Which word is the gerund? The chef loves cooking with fresh food.
Which sentence is correct?

practiceSets.title: Final Review HW2 — Infinitive or Gerund
practiceSets.description: From the June 5 homework: choose to + verb or V-ing based on the sentence.

items.q: Mr. Wahl enjoys ____ tennis on the weekends. (play)
Mr. Wesson finished ____ his book last weekend. (read)
Mr. Melrose would like ____ lots of photos tomorrow. (take)
All the students want ____ to their teachers in class. (listen)
Their teachers expect ____ a long time for silence in class. (wait)
I dislike ____ books without any pictures. (read)
They hope ____ their favorite song on the radio. (hear)
You need ____ your homework diligently to stay out of trouble. (do)
